identity_marker: the dark-themed ProtonMail desktop web interface displayed on a flat-screen computer monitor with a white arrow mouse cursor
continuity_anchors: under soft, ambient office lighting with a blurred, neutral-toned desk background
video_goal: Demonstrate how to navigate ProtonMail settings to enable and configure an out-of-office auto-reply for international travel.
single_prompt: A screen capture shows the dark-themed ProtonMail desktop web interface displayed on a flat-screen computer monitor with a white arrow mouse cursor under soft, ambient office lighting with a blurred, neutral-toned desk background. The mouse cursor glides to the top-right corner and clicks the Settings gear icon, opening a quick-settings dropdown menu. The cursor moves down and clicks 'All settings', transitioning the interface to the Settings dashboard. On the left-hand navigation sidebar, the cursor hovers over and clicks 'Auto-reply', updating the main right-hand panel to display the Auto-reply configuration settings. The cursor clicks the toggle switch next to 'Auto-reply', changing it from a grey 'off' state to a purple 'on' state. Moving down to the 'Duration' section, the cursor clicks the 'Start date' text field, prompting a calendar widget to pop up. The cursor selects a specific date and time slot, then clicks the 'End date' field to select a date two weeks later. The cursor moves down to the rich text editor box labeled 'Message' and clicks inside, making a blinking text cursor appear. Text rapidly appears spelling out: 'I am currently on international travel in a different time zone with limited connectivity.' The cursor highlights 'international travel' and clicks the 'B' (Bold) icon on the formatting toolbar. Finally, the cursor scrolls to the bottom, clicks the solid purple 'Save' button, and a green notification banner with a checkmark and 'Auto-reply saved' slides up from the bottom center of the screen.
